Three ways to declare variables — differ in scope, hoisting, and mutability. Explain the difference between var, let, and const. When would you use each? Scope Wo ilaaka jahan variable dikhta hai. Re-assign Variable ko nayi value dena. Re-declare Ussi naam se dobara variable banana. Teen tarike hain variable banane ke, aur teen cheezon mein farak hai: scope , hoisting , aur badal sakte ho ya nahi . var purana hai — poore function mein dikhta hai. let aur const naye hain — sirf apne { } block mein dikhte hain.

JS moves declarations (not initializations) to the top of their scope before execution. What is hoisting? How does it behave differently for var vs let/const vs functions? Hoisting Chalne se pehle JS saari declarations ko upar utha leta hai — value ko nahi. TDZ Temporal Dead Zone — block ke shuru se declaration tak ka wo hissa jahan let/const ko chhoo nahi sakte. Code chalne se pehle JS ek baar poora scan karta hai aur saare declarations note kar leta hai. Par value wahin par set hoti hai jahan likhi hai. Isliye var declare se pehle use karne par undefined milta hai — variable exist karta hai, par value nahi aayi.

Primitives are copied by value; objects/arrays are copied by reference. What is the difference between primitive and reference types in JavaScript? Primitive Simple value — number, string, boolean, null, undefined, symbol, bigint. Reference Object, array, function — inka pata (address) variable mein rehta hai, khud value nahi. Primitive variable mein value khud rehti hai. Copy karoge to nayi alag value banti hai. Reference variable mein sirf pata rehta hai — asli object kahin aur (heap mein) hota hai. Copy karoge to pata copy hota hai, object nahi. Do naam, ek hi ghar.

JS automatically converts types when mixing incompatible values in operations. Explain implicit vs explicit type coercion. Why is 0 == false true but 0 === false false? Coercion JS ka khud-ba-khud type badal dena. Implicit Aapne nahi bola, JS ne khud kiya — "5" * 2 . Explicit Aapne khud badla — Number("5") . Jab do alag types ko mila do, JS unhe ek jaisa banane ki koshish karta hai — chahe uska matlab bane ya na bane. Do niyam yaad rakho: + string ki taraf jhukta hai (agar ek bhi string ho to jodna nahi, chipkana hota hai). Baaki saare operators number ki taraf jhukte hain .

== allows type coercion; === checks value AND type without conversion. When would you ever want to use == over ===? Give a real use case. == (loose) Type badal kar compare karta hai. === (strict) Type bhi same hona chahiye, tabhi true. Object.is === jaisa, par NaN aur -0 ko theek se handle karta hai. === seedha hai: type same + value same , tabhi true . == pehle types ko ek jaisa banata hai, phir compare karta hai. Isi "pehle badalna" mein sab gadbad hoti hai.

Three "empty" values with different semantics: intentional absence, uninitialized, and failed numeric op. What is the difference between null, undefined, and NaN? How do you reliably check for each? undefined Value di hi nahi gayi — JS ne khud lagayi. null Value jaan-boojh kar khaali rakhi gayi — aapne lagayi. NaN Not a Number — number wala kaam fail ho gaya. Teeno "kuch nahi" jaise lagte hain, par unka matlab alag hai: undefined = "kisi ne value di hi nahi". null = "maine jaan-boojh kar khaali rakha". NaN = "number banane ki koshish ki, ban nahi paya".

Scope determines where variables are visible. JS has global, function, and block scopes. Explain the three types of scope in JavaScript with examples. Scope Wo ilaaka jahan ek variable dikhta hai. Scope chain Variable na mile to JS bahar wale scope mein dhundta hai — global tak. Lexical Scope ka faisla code likhne ki jagah se hota hai, chalane ki jagah se nahi. Teen tarah ke ilaake hote hain: global (poori file), function (ek function ke andar), aur block (ek { } ke andar — sirf let / const ke liye). Jab JS ko koi variable chahiye, wo andar se bahar ki taraf dhundhta hai — apne scope mein, phir uske bahar wale mein, phir global tak. Ise scope chain kehte h

A function that "remembers" variables from its outer scope even after that scope has returned. What is a closure? Give a real-world use case and a common pitfall. Scope Wo ilaaka jahan ek variable dikhta hai. Closure Ek function jo apne bahar wale variables yaad rakhta hai — bahar wala function khatam hone ke baad bhi. Function ke andar function banao, to andar wale ko bahar wale ke variables dikhte hain. Ye normal hai. Kamaal ye hai: bahar wala khatam ho jaane ke baad bhi andar wala un variables ko yaad rakhta hai. Wo mitte nahi. Usi ko closure kehte hain.

JS creates a context for every function call; the call stack tracks the current execution chain. What is an execution context? What gets created when a function is invoked? Execution context Ek dabba jo batata hai: abhi kaunsa code chal raha hai, uske variables kya hain, aur this kya hai. Call stack In dabbon ki dher. Sabse upar wala abhi chal raha hai. Jab bhi koi function chalta hai, JS uske liye ek naya dabba banata hai — usme us function ke variables, uska scope chain, aur uska this rehta hai. Ye dabbe ek dher (stack) mein lagte hain. Sabse upar wala chal raha hota hai; wo khatam hote hi hat jaata hai aur neeche wala aage badhta hai.

`this` refers to the object that is executing the current function — its value depends on call context. Explain how `this` is determined. What are the four rules of binding? this Wo object jispe function abhi chal raha hai. Call-site Wo jagah jahan se function bulaya gaya — yahi this tay karta hai. this ki value function likhne se tay nahi hoti — bulane se tay hoti hai. Yahi ek line poora confusion khatam kar deti hai. Ek hi function alag jagah se bulane par alag this dega.

Concise function syntax that lexically binds `this` and cannot be used as constructors. How are arrow functions different from regular functions? List at least 3 differences. Arrow function Chhota syntax — aur uska apna this , arguments nahi hota. Implicit return Curly braces na ho to value apne aap return ho jaati hai. Arrow function sirf chhota syntax nahi hai. Uske paas apna this hota hi nahi — wo jahan likha gaya hai, wahan ka this udhaar leta hai. Isi ek farak se tay hota hai ki kab arrow use karna hai aur kab nahi.

Functions that take other functions as arguments or return them — the basis of functional JS. What is a higher-order function? Implement map, filter, and reduce from scratch. Higher-order function Aisa function jo doosra function leta hai ya lautata hai. Callback Wo function jo aap kisi aur function ko de dete ho ki "ise chala lena". JavaScript mein function ek normal value hai — use variable mein rakh sakte ho, argument mein bhej sakte ho, return kar sakte ho. Jo function doosre function ko leta ya lautata hai, use higher-order function kehte hain. map , filter , setTimeout , addEventListener — sab yahi hain.

Transforming a multi-argument function into a sequence of single-argument functions. Explain currying. Write a curry function that works for any number of arguments. Currying Ek function jo kai arguments leta tha, use ek-ek argument lene wale functions ki chain mein todna. Partial application Kuch arguments abhi de dena, baaki baad mein. add(a, b, c) ko add(a)(b)(c) bana dena — yahi currying hai. Faayda ye hai ki aap kuch arguments pehle bhar kar ek naya, chhota function bana sakte ho.

A function that runs the moment it is defined — used to create isolated scope. What is an IIFE? Why was it heavily used before ES6 modules? IIFE Immediately Invoked Function Expression — banate hi turant chalne wala function. Namespace Apna alag ilaaka taaki naam global mein na takraayein. Ek function jo likhte hi turant chal jaata hai: (function(){ ... })() . Uska ek hi maqsad tha — ek apna scope bana lena, taaki andar ke variables global mein na jaayein.

Methods to explicitly set `this` for a function call. bind returns a new function; call/apply invoke immediately. What is the difference between call, apply, and bind? Implement bind from scratch. call this aur arguments alag-alag do, turant chalao. apply Wahi, par arguments array mein. bind Turant nahi chalata — ek naya function deta hai jiska this fix ho gaya. Teeno ek hi kaam ke liye hain: this khud tay karna . call aur apply function ko turant chalate hain (bas arguments dene ka tarika alag hai). bind chalata nahi — wo ek naya function deta hai jiska this hamesha ke liye fix ho gaya.

Caching the result of expensive function calls so repeated calls with the same input are fast. Implement a generic memoize function. What are its tradeoffs? Memoization Function ke jawab ko yaad rakh lena, taaki wahi input dobara aaye to dobara calculate na karna pade. Cache Wo jagah jahan purane jawab rakhe jaate hain. Pure function Wahi input → hamesha wahi output, aur duniya mein kuch na badle. Agar ek function bhaari hai aur wahi input baar-baar aata hai, to har baar calculate karna barbaadi hai. Jawab ek cache (aksar Map) mein rakh lo. Agli baar wahi input aaye to seedha wahan se de do.

The mechanism that lets JS be non-blocking: picks tasks from the queue when the call stack is empty. Explain the event loop. What is the difference between the microtask queue and macrotask queue? Call stack Jo kaam abhi chal raha hai uski dher. Ek waqt mein ek. Macrotask Normal line — setTimeout , click, fetch jawab. Microtask VIP line — Promise.then , await ke baad ka code. JS ek waqt mein ek hi kaam karta hai. Phir 5 second ka network call page ko jam kyu nahi karta? Kyunki JS wo kaam khud nahi karta — browser ko de deta hai aur aage badh jaata hai. Jawab aane par wo ek line mein lag jaata hai. Event loop wo chowkidaar hai jo poochta rehta hai: "stack khaali hai? To l

Passing a function to be executed after an async operation — leads to nested "pyramid of doom". What is a callback? What is callback hell and what problems does it cause? Callback Wo function jo aap kisi aur ko de dete ho — "kaam khatam ho jaaye to ise chala dena". Callback hell Callbacks ke andar callbacks — code daayein taraf jhukta chala jaata hai. JS ko kuch lamba kaam karna ho (network, file, timer), to wo ruk kar wait nahi karta. Aap use ek function de dete ho: "jab ho jaaye to ise chala dena" . Wahi callback hai. Problem tab aati hai jab ek kaam ke baad doosra, phir teesra — har ek dusre ke andar ghusta jaata hai.

Objects representing eventual completion or failure of an async operation, with then/catch chaining. Explain how a Promise works internally. What are the three states? Promise Ek dabba jo kehta hai "jawab abhi nahi hai, par aayega — ya to value ya error". pending / fulfilled / rejected Teen haalatein. Ek baar pending se nikal gaya to phir kabhi nahi badalta. Chaining .then() hamesha naya promise deta hai — isliye chain banti hai. Promise ek rasid hai. Kaam abhi khatam nahi hua, par aapke paas ek cheez hai jispe aap keh sakte ho "jab ho jaaye to mujhe batana". Uski teen haalatein hain: pending (chal raha hai), fulfilled (ho gaya, value hai), rejected (fail hua, error hai). Ek baar tay ho gaya

Syntactic sugar over Promises that makes async code look synchronous using generator-like pausing. How does async/await work under the hood? What does await actually do? async Function ko promise lautane wala bana deta hai. await Promise ke jawab ka intezaar — par thread block nahi hota. async/await koi nayi cheez nahi hai — wo promises ke upar chhota syntax hai. Andar wahi promises chal rahe hote hain. await ka matlab hai: "yahan ruk jao, jawab aane par aage badhna". Par wo poore program ko nahi rokta — sirf ye function rukta hai; baaki code chalta rehta hai.

Promise.all, .race, .allSettled, .any — each handles multiple concurrent promises differently. When would you use Promise.all vs Promise.allSettled vs Promise.race vs Promise.any? all Sab safal hon tabhi safal. Ek bhi fail → poora fail. allSettled Sabka intezaar karo, chahe fail hon — sabka result do. race Jo pehle khatam ho (safal ya fail), wahi jawab. any Jo pehle SAFAL ho. Sab fail hon tabhi fail. Chaar tareeke hain kai promises ko ek saath sambhalne ke. Farak sirf ek baat mein hai: kab khatam maana jaaye, aur fail hone par kya karein.

Functions that can pause and resume execution using yield — the foundation of async/await internals. What is a generator function? What problem does it solve? How does it relate to async/await? Generator Aisa function jo beech mein ruk sakta hai aur baad mein wahin se aage badh sakta hai. yield Wo jagah jahan function rukta hai aur ek value bahar deta hai. Iterator Ek cheez jiske paas next() ho jo {value, done} lautaye. Normal function ek baar chala to poora chal kar hi rukta hai. Generator ( function* ) beech mein ruk sakta hai — yield par. Aur sabse kaam ki baat: ruka hua kaun rakhta hai? Bahar wala. Aap next() bulao, tabhi wo aage badhega.

Microtasks (Promise callbacks, queueMicrotask) run before the next macrotask (setTimeout, setInterval). What is the difference between microtasks and macrotasks? Predict the output of a tricky async snippet. Macrotask Normal line — setTimeout , setInterval , I/O, UI events. Microtask VIP line — Promise.then , await , queueMicrotask , MutationObserver . Starvation Microtasks khatam hi na hon to macrotasks kabhi nahi chalte — page jam. Do alag lines hain, aur unka niyam ek line mein: ek macrotask chalao → poori microtask line khaali karo → tab agla macrotask . Isliye Promise.then hamesha setTimeout(fn, 0) se pehle chalta hai, chahe setTimeout pehle likha ho.

Every JS object has a hidden __proto__ link forming a chain up to Object.prototype for property lookup. Explain the prototype chain. How does property lookup work in JavaScript? Prototype Ek object jispe doosre object apne "na mile to yahan dekho" ka pata rakhte hain. __proto__ Object ka apne prototype tak ka link. prototype Function ki wo property jo new se bane objects ka prototype banti hai. JS mein har object ke paas ek chhupa hua link hota hai — apne prototype tak. Jab aap obj.foo maangte ho aur wo object par nahi hai, JS us link par chala jaata hai. Wahan bhi nahi mila to aur upar. null tak. Isi chain ko prototype chain kehte hain. Yahi JS ka inheritance hai.

Syntactic sugar over prototype-based inheritance — classes don't add new OOP semantics, just cleaner syntax. Are JavaScript classes "real" classes? What is happening under the hood? class Prototype-based inheritance ka saaf syntax. Andar prototypes hi chalte hain. Syntactic sugar Naya kaam nahi, purane kaam ka behtar likhne ka tarika. #field Asli private field — bahar se chhua hi nahi ja sakta. class JavaScript mein koi nayi cheez nahi laayi . Wo wahi prototype chain hai, bas likhne ka tarika saaf ho gaya. class Dog { bark(){} } asal mein Dog.prototype.bark hi banata hai.

JS uses object-to-object delegation, not class-to-instance. extends sets up the prototype chain. Explain the difference between prototypal and classical inheritance. When is composition better? Prototypal Object seedha doosre object se cheezein leta hai. Classical Class se class — Java/C++ wala tarika. JS mein ye asli nahi hai. Composition Inheritance ki jagah cheezein jod kar banana. Java mein class ek blueprint hai aur objects usse bante hain. JS mein object seedha doosre object se cheezein leta hai — koi blueprint beech mein nahi. class ... extends Java jaisa dikhta hai, par andar wahi prototype linking chal rahi hoti hai.

Creates a blank object, sets its prototype, runs the constructor with `this`, and returns the object. What does the new keyword do step by step? What happens if a constructor returns an object? new Function ko constructor ki tarah chalata hai aur naya object banata hai. Constructor Wo function jo new ke saath bulaya jaata hai. new Foo() lagane par JS chaar cheezein karta hai, ussi order mein: 1. Ek khaali object banata hai. 2. Us object ka prototype Foo.prototype set karta hai. 3. Foo ko chalata hai jisme this = wo naya object. 4. Object return karta hai (jab tak function khud koi object return na kare).

Built-in methods to create, copy, and lock down objects at the property descriptor level. What is the difference between Object.freeze and Object.seal? When would you use each? Object.create Diye hue prototype ke saath naya object. Object.assign Ek object mein doosre ki properties copy (shallow). freeze / seal freeze = kuch bhi mat badlo. seal = nayi mat jodo, purani badal sakte ho. Chaar utility jo objects ke saath roz kaam aati hain — aur teeno freeze/seal wale sirf upar ke level par kaam karte hain.

Combining functionality from multiple sources without inheritance — prefer composition over inheritance. What is a mixin in JavaScript? How does it solve the diamond problem of multiple inheritance? Mixin Behaviour ka ek tukda jise kai classes/objects mein mila diya jaaye. Composition Inheritance ki jagah cheezein jod kar banana. JS mein ek class ka ek hi baap ho sakta hai. Par aksar behaviour do-teen jagah se chahiye hota hai. Mixin uska jugaad hai: behaviour ko ek plain object ya function mein rakho, aur jise chahiye usme mila do .

Automatic memory management using mark-and-sweep: objects with no reachable references are freed. How does JavaScript garbage collection work? What can cause memory leaks? Garbage collection JS ka khud purani memory free karna. Reachable Wo object jis tak root (global, stack) se koi raasta bacha ho. Mark and sweep GC ka tarika: root se chal kar sab reachable ko mark karo, baaki saaf kar do. JS mein memory aap free nahi karte — engine karta hai. Uska niyam ek hi hai: jo object ab reachable nahi hai, wo saaf ho jaayega. Reachable matlab: global, current stack, ya kisi reachable object se uska koi raasta bacha ho.

When objects remain in memory unintentionally — detached DOM nodes, forgotten timers, global variables. What are the most common memory leak patterns? How do you detect and fix them? Memory leak Aisi memory jo ab zarurat nahi, par kuch use pakde hue hai isliye free nahi hoti. Detached DOM Wo DOM node jo page se hat gaya par JS abhi bhi use pakde hue hai. Leak ka matlab "memory bhar gayi" nahi hai — matlab hai kisi ne kuch pakad rakha hai jiski zarurat khatam ho chuki hai . JS mein iske chaar hi bade karan hain, aur chaaron pehchanne layak hain.

Debounce delays execution until activity stops; throttle limits execution to at most once per interval. What is the difference between debounce and throttle? Implement both from scratch. Debounce Shaant hone ka intezaar — user ruk jaaye tab chalao. Throttle Ek time mein ek baar — bhale user kitna bhi kare. Dono taaki bar-bar chalne wala kaam kam ho — par soch ulti hai: Debounce: "jab tak event aate rahenge, main rukа rahunga. Ruk jaaye to chalunga." Throttle: "main har X ms mein ek baar zaroor chalunga, chahe event kitne bhi aayein."

Deferring computation until the value is actually needed — generators, Proxy, and on-demand patterns. What is lazy evaluation? How can generators enable lazy sequences in JS? Lazy Kaam tabhi karo jab jawab sach mein chahiye. Eager Sab kuch pehle hi kar dalo — chahe zarurat pade ya na pade. Short-circuit && / || ka jawab pata chalte hi ruk jaana. Lazy ka matlab: calculate mat karo jab tak koi maange nahi. JS mein ye kai jagah pehle se hai — && / || ka short-circuit, generators, aur dynamic import() .

Run JS on a background thread separate from the main thread to avoid blocking the UI. What are Web Workers? What are their limitations? How do they communicate with the main thread? Web Worker Ek alag thread jahan JS chalta hai — main thread ko block kiye bina. postMessage Worker aur main thread ke beech baat karne ka tarika. Structured clone Message bhejte waqt data ki copy banti hai — reference nahi jaata. JS main thread par ek waqt mein ek kaam. Bhaari calculation poora UI jam kar deti hai. Worker ek alag thread deta hai. Wahan calculation chalti rahegi aur UI chalta rahega. Baat postMessage se hoti hai.

ESM uses import/export (static, tree-shakable); CJS uses require() (dynamic, synchronous). What is the difference between ES Modules and CommonJS? Why does it matter for bundlers? ESM ES Modules — import / export . Aaj ka standard. CommonJS Node ka purana tarika — require / module.exports . Tree shaking Bundler ka unused code hata dena — sirf ESM mein mumkin. Do system hain code ko files mein baantne ke. Sabse bada farak: ESM chalne se pehle padha jaata hai (static), CommonJS chalte waqt (dynamic). Isi ek farak se sab kuch nikalta hai — tree shaking, top-level await, aur circular imports ka behaviour.

Ensures only one instance of an object exists — commonly used for config stores or DB connections. Implement the Singleton pattern in JavaScript. What are its downsides? Singleton Aisa pattern jisme poore app mein us cheez ka ek hi instance ho. Global state Aisi cheez jo poore app mein ek ho aur kahin se bhi chhui ja sake. "Is cheez ka poore app mein ek hi hona chahiye" — jaise ek database connection, ek config, ek logger. JS mein iska sabse saaf tarika alag hai: module khud singleton hai. Module ek hi baar chalta hai aur uska export cache ho jaata hai — to bas ek object export kar do.

Objects subscribe to events; publisher notifies all subscribers — decouples sender from receivers. Implement a simple EventEmitter (on, emit, off) from scratch. Observer / PubSub Kuch hua to jinhe matlab hai unhe khabar mil jaaye. Subject Wo cheez jispe kuch hota hai. Subscriber Wo jo khabar sunta hai. Ek cheez badle to jinhe matlab hai unhe khud-ba-khud pata chal jaaye — aur badalne wale ko ye jaanne ki zarurat na ho ki kaun sun raha hai. Aap ye pehle se use karte ho: addEventListener bilkul yahi hai.

A function or class that creates and returns objects without the caller knowing the exact type. What is the factory pattern? How does it differ from using the new keyword directly? Factory Ek function jo object banata hai — caller ko "kaunsa" ka faisla nahi karna padta. Factory function JS mein class ke bina object banane ka aam tarika. Object banane ka faisla ek jagah rakho. Caller bas kehta hai "mujhe ye chahiye" — kaunsi class banegi, ye factory tay karti hai. JS mein iska ek aur roop hai: factory function — new ke bina object banana, closure ke saath private data.

Proxy intercepts object operations (get, set, delete); Reflect provides default behaviour for those ops. What can you do with Proxy that you cannot do otherwise? Give a real use case. Proxy Ek object ke aage khada pehredaar — har read/write use se hokar jaata hai. Trap Wo function jo kisi operation ko pakadta hai — get , set , has . Reflect Default behaviour chalane ka saaf tarika — Reflect.get(...) . Proxy ek object ke aage khada ho jaata hai. Ab koi bhi us object se kuch padhega ya likhega, wo pehle aapke paas aayega. Aap wahan validation, logging, default values — kuch bhi laga sakte ho.

Unique, non-string primitive used as private(-ish) object keys; well-known symbols customize language behaviour. What problem does Symbol solve? What is Symbol.iterator and how do you use it? Symbol Ek hamesha-unique value. Do symbols kabhi barabar nahi hote. Well-known symbols JS ke apne symbols jo language ke behaviour ko hook karte hain. Symbol("id") har baar ek bilkul nayi value deta hai — chahe naam same ho. Isliye object key ke liye ye kabhi takra nahi sakta. Aur JS ke apne kuch symbols hain ( Symbol.iterator jaise) jinse aap language ka behaviour badal sakte ho.

Attaching a single listener to a parent instead of many children — exploits event bubbling. What is event delegation? Why is it a performance pattern? When does it fail? Bubbling Event child se shuru hokar upar parents tak jaata hai. Delegation Har child par listener lagane ki jagah ek parent par lagana. e.target Wo element jispe asal mein click hua. 1000 rows hain aur har row par delete button. 1000 listeners lagaoge? Nahi — ek listener parent par lagao. Event bubble hokar wahan aayega, aur e.target se pata chal jaayega ki kis par click hua.

Changing the DOM triggers layout recalculation (reflow) and repainting — expensive in bulk. What is the difference between repaint and reflow? How do you batch DOM changes to minimise cost? Reflow (layout) Browser dobara naapta hai ki kya kahan hai — mehnga. Repaint Sirf rang/dikhawat badalna — reflow se sasta. Layout thrashing Baar-baar likhna-padhna, jisse har baar reflow force hota hai. DOM badalna JS ka sabse mehnga kaam hai. Har badlav browser ko dobara layout naapne ( reflow ) ya paint karne par majboor kar sakta hai. Sabse bada bug: layout thrashing — loop mein likho, phir padho, phir likho. Har padhne par browser ko turant reflow karna padta hai.

Four client-side storage mechanisms with different persistence, capacity, and security characteristics. Compare localStorage, sessionStorage, cookies, and IndexedDB. When do you use each? localStorage ~5MB, hamesha ke liye rehta hai, sync (blocking). sessionStorage Wahi, par tab band hote hi mit jaata hai. IndexedDB Bada database, async, structured data. Cookie ~4KB, har request ke saath server ko jaata hai. Chaar jagah hain browser mein data rakhne ki. Chunav teen sawaal se hota hai: kitna bada , kab tak rahe , aur server ko chahiye ya nahi .

Fetch is a modern Promise-based HTTP API; XHR is the older callback/event approach. How does fetch work? What does it return? How is it different from axios? fetch Promise-based network API — aaj ka standard. XHR Purana XMLHttpRequest — callback based. AbortController Chal rahi request ko cancel karne ka tarika. fetch promise deta hai aur padhne mein saaf hai. Par uski ek cheez sabko chaunkati hai : fetch 404 ya 500 par reject nahi hota. Wo sirf network fail (internet gaya) par reject hota hai. Status khud check karna padta hai.

Background scripts that intercept network requests — enable offline-first PWAs and cache strategies. What is a Service Worker? What is its lifecycle? How does it enable offline support? Service Worker Ek script jo aapke page aur network ke beech baithti hai. Cache API Requests aur responses store karne ki jagah. Offline-first Pehle cache se do, background mein update karo. Service worker ek proxy hai jo browser mein chalta hai. Har network request usse hokar jaati hai — aur aap tay kar sakte ho ki cache se dena hai ya network se. Isi se PWA offline chalte hain.

Any object with [Symbol.iterator] is iterable; the iterator protocol defines how values are produced one by one. What is the iterator protocol? How do you make a custom object work with for...of? Iterable Aisi cheez jispe for...of chal sake — usme Symbol.iterator hota hai. Iterator Wo cheez jiske paas next() ho jo {value, done} lautaye. for...of , spread ( ... ), destructuring — ye sab ek hi cheez par khade hain: iterable protocol . Koi bhi object jisme [Symbol.iterator]() ho, ye sab kuch apne aap kaam karne lagta hai.

Syntactic patterns to unpack values from arrays/objects and gather/spread elements. Explain destructuring with default values, renaming, and nested patterns. What about rest/spread? Destructuring Object/array se values seedha variables mein nikalna. Rest (...) Bache hue elements ek jagah jama karna. Spread (...) Ek cheez ko khol kar phailana. Destructuring se object/array ke andar se values seedha nikal sakte ho — bina obj.a , obj.b likhe. ... do kaam karta hai: rest (bache hue jama karo) aur spread (khol kar phailao). Jagah se pata chalta hai kaunsa hai.

n: Regular Expressions — patterns, groups, lookaheads, common pitfalls
x: RegExp for pattern matching. Named groups (? ), lookaheads (?=...), lookbehinds (? ( ) se pakda hua hissa jo alag se nikala ja sake. Lookahead (?=...) — "iske aage ye hona chahiye", par match mein shaamil nahi. Regex ek chhoti language hai text ke pattern ke liye. Basics 20 minute mein aa jaate hain; baaki reference dekh kar kaam chal jaata hai. Jo cheezein roz kaam aati hain wo gine-chune hain — neeche wahi hain.

n: JSON — parse, stringify, revivers, replacers, toJSON
x: JSON.parse with reviver function for custom deserialization. JSON.stringify with replacer for filtering/formatting. toJSON method on objects for custom serialization. JSON.stringify loses functions, undefined, Symbol, Infinity, Date (to string). What does JSON.stringify lose? How do you serialize a Date object properly? stringify JS value → JSON string. parse JSON string → JS value. replacer / reviver Convert karte waqt beech mein value badalne wala function. Do methods, par unke chhupe hue niyam hi asli sawaal hain — kyunki JSON JavaScript ke saare types support nahi karta.

n: Date/Time — Date, Intl.DateTimeFormat, Temporal API, timezone handling
x: Date is notoriously difficult (mutable, poor API). Intl.DateTimeFormat for locale-aware formatting. Temporal API (Stage 3) replaces Date with immutable, timezone-aware types. moment.js/date-fns/luxon are popular alternatives. What are the problems with JavaScript's Date object? How does the Temporal API improve on it? Date JS ka purana date object — bahut sare gotchas ke saath. Intl Locale ke hisaab se format karne ka built-in tarika. Temporal Naya API jo Date ki saari problems theek karta hai. Date JavaScript ka sabse kharab design mana jaata hai — month 0 se shuru, mutable, aur timezone ka behaviour ajeeb. Aaj ka tarika: formatting ke liye Intl , calculation ke liye library (date-fns/Day.j

try/catch/finally is JS error handling. catch blocks receive the error object. finally always runs (even after return). Errors propagate up the call stack if uncaught. throw can re-throw or throw new errors. Explain try/catch/finally execution order. What happens if catch also throws? throw Galti phenkna — code wahin ruk kar upar chala jaata hai. catch Phenki hui galti pakadna. finally Chahe kuch bhi ho — ye hamesha chalta hai. Propagation Error upar ki taraf chadhta hai jab tak koi pakad na le. throw hone par function wahin ruk jaata hai aur error upar chadhta hai — jisne bulaya tha, uske paas. Wahan bhi catch na ho to aur upar. Kahin bhi na pakda jaaye to program crash. finally hamesha cha

n: Error Types — TypeError, ReferenceError, SyntaxError, RangeError
x: TypeError: wrong type (e.g. calling non-function). ReferenceError: undefined variable. SyntaxError: invalid code. RangeError: value out of range. Each has distinct causes and debugging approaches. What is the difference between TypeError and ReferenceError? Give examples of each. TypeError Value ka type galat — undefined par method bulana. ReferenceError Aisa variable jo hai hi nahi. SyntaxError Code likhne mein galti — chalne se pehle hi. RangeError Value allowed range se bahar. JS ke apne error types hain, aur error ka naam hi aadha jawab hota hai — kis tarah ki galti hui, wo turant bata deta hai.

n: Custom Error Classes — extending Error, error codes
x: Extend Error to create domain-specific errors (ValidationError, NotFoundError). Set name, message, and custom properties (statusCode, code). Enables typed catch blocks and better API error responses. How do you create a custom error class in JavaScript? Why would you? Custom error Apni Error class — extends Error . Error code Machine ke padhne layak pehchaan — "AUTH_EXPIRED" . cause Asli wajah wale error ko naye error ke saath jodna. throw new Error("kuch galat") se caller ko sirf ek string milti hai — aur string se code faisla nahi kar sakta. Apni Error class banao: ab caller instanceof se pehchan sakta hai, aur error apne saath data bhi le jaa sakta hai.

n: Async Error Handling — unhandled rejections, .catch(), global handlers
x: Unhandled promise rejections crash Node.js (>=15). Always .catch() or use try/await. window.onunhandledrejection catches browser unhandled rejections. process.on("unhandledRejection") for Node. Error boundaries catch React render errors. What happens when a Promise rejects without a .catch()? How do you handle async errors globally? Unhandled rejection Aisa rejected promise jispe koi .catch nahi laga. Global handler Aakhri jaal — jo error kahin nahi pakda gaya, wo yahan aata hai. Async errors sync errors se alag behave karte hain, aur yahi sabse zyada bugs banata hai. Do niyam: (1) callback ke andar ka throw bahar ke try/catch mein nahi aata. (2) Promise par .catch na ho to error chup-chaap

n: Debugging — console methods, debugger statement, DevTools profiling
x: console.table/warn/error/group for structured logging. debugger statement pauses execution. DevTools Profiler shows CPU usage. Network tab shows requests. Memory tab detects leaks. Source maps help debug minified code. What console methods do you use for debugging? When would you use console.table vs console.log? debugger Code mein likha ek shabd jo DevTools khula ho to wahan rok deta hai. Breakpoint Wo line jahan code ruk jaaye taaki state dekh sako. Source map Minified code ko wapas asli code se jodne wali file. console.log se aage bhi bahut kuch hai — aur uska aadha hissa debugging ka waqt aadha kar deta hai.

n: Map & Set — when to use over objects, iteration, performance
x: Map preserves insertion order, accepts any key type, has size property. Set stores unique values. Both have O(1) lookup like objects but better for non-string keys. WeakMap/WeakSet allow garbage collection of keys. What is the difference between Map and plain objects? When would you use Set over an array? Map Key-value store jahan key kuch bhi ho sakti hai, aur order yaad rehta hai. Set Unique values ka collection. Object bhi key-value rakhta hai — phir Map kyu? Teen wajah: Map ki key kuch bhi ho sakti hai (object, function), usme insertion order pakka hai, aur .size seedha milta hai. Aur bade data par add/delete tez hai.

WeakMap keys must be objects and are weakly held (GC can collect them). WeakSet holds objects weakly. Use WeakMap for private data, caching, and metadata without preventing garbage collection. What is a WeakMap? How does it differ from Map in terms of garbage collection? WeakMap Keys ko pakadta nahi — GC unhe saaf kar sakta hai. GC-friendly Aisa collection jo memory leak nahi banata. Normal Map apni keys ko pakad kar rakhta hai. To agar key ek DOM node hai aur wo page se hat jaaye, wo phir bhi memory mein rahegi — kyunki Map use pakde hue hai. WeakMap pakadta nahi. Object kahin aur se reachable na ho to wo aur uski entry dono saaf.

TypeScript infers types automatically from values. The type system is structural. Const infers literal types; let infers widened types. What is the difference between type inference and explicit annotation? When does TypeScript infer the wrong type and you must annotate explicitly? Type inference TypeScript khud samajh leta hai ki value kis type ki hai — aapko likhna nahi padta. Widening let ke saath type chauda ho jaata hai — "hi" se string ban jaata hai. Literal type Type jo sirf ek hi value allow kare — jaise "hi" . TypeScript zyadatar type khud pehchan leta hai . const x = 5 likhne par usko pata hai ki ye number hai — : number likhne ki zarurat nahi. Par ek chhota farak hai: const se typ

Both describe object shapes. interface supports declaration merging and is open for extension. type is more flexible — supports unions, intersections, tuples, and mapped types. When would you use type over interface and vice versa? What is declaration merging and when is it useful or dangerous? interface Object ka naksha. Dobara declare karne par merge ho jaata hai. type alias Kisi bhi type ko naam dena — union, primitive, function, object. Declaration merging Do ek naam ke interface apne aap jud jaate hain. 90% cases mein dono ek jaise hain. Do asli farak hain: 1. type kuch bhi naam de sakta hai — union, primitive, tuple. interface sirf object shape. 2. interface ek hi naam se dobara likhne

Union (A | B): the value can be either type. Intersection (A & B): the value must satisfy both types simultaneously. Explain union vs intersection with real examples. When does an intersection type produce never and why? Union (|) "Ya to ye, ya wo" — dono mein se koi ek. Intersection (&) "Ye bhi aur wo bhi" — dono ek saath. Narrowing Union mein se ek type tak pahunchna, check laga kar. | aur & ka matlab ulta lagta hai, aur yahi sabse aam confusion hai. A | B = value A ya B ho sakti hai. Isliye aap sirf wahi use kar sakte ho jo dono mein ho — kam properties. A & B = value mein A aur B dono ke fields hain. Zyada properties.

Literal types narrow a type to an exact value (e.g. "GET"). as const freezes an object's inferred types to their literal values, preventing widening. What is a literal type? What does as const do that a regular type annotation cannot? Why is it crucial for arrays used as tuples? Literal type Type jo sirf ek hi value allow kare — "up" , 42 , true . as const Poori cheez ko literal types mein lock kar do — object aur array bhi. Ek type jo sirf ek value allow karta hai. Akele bekaar lagta hai, par union ke saath ye TypeScript ka sabse kaam ka feature ban jaata hai. "small" | "medium" | "large" — ab chauthi value likhi hi nahi ja sakti, aur editor teeno suggest karta hai.

TypeScript refines a union type to a narrower type inside conditional blocks using control-flow analysis — typeof, instanceof, in, equality checks, and type predicates. List all the ways to narrow a type in TypeScript. What is a type predicate (is) and when do you need one vs relying on built-in narrowing? Narrowing Union se ek specific type tak pahunchna, check laga kar. Control flow analysis TypeScript ka aapke if ko padh kar type ka andaza lagana. Discriminant Wo common field jiski value se pata chale ki kaunsa member hai. TypeScript aapke if ko padhta hai. if (typeof x === "string") ke andar wo jaanta hai ki x string hai — aap x.toUpperCase() likh sakte ho. Ise control flow analysis keht

With strictNullChecks on, null and undefined are their own distinct types — you must explicitly handle them. The non-null assertion (!) removes them unsafely. What changes when you enable strictNullChecks? Explain the non-null assertion operator (!) and when it is a code smell vs genuinely necessary. strictNullChecks TS ka wo flag jo null / undefined ko alag types maanta hai. Non-null assertion (!) "Main kasam khata hu ye null nahi hai" — compiler chup ho jaata hai. Optional (?) Field ho bhi sakta hai, na bhi ho. Bina strictNullChecks ke null har type mein chhupa baithta hai — string ka matlab "string ya null" ho jaata hai, aur TypeScript aapko bacha nahi paata. Iske saath null aur undefined

n: Enums vs const enum vs Union Types
x: Regular enums generate a runtime JS object. const enums are erased at compile time (inlined). String literal unions are the modern, zero-runtime alternative. What is the difference between a regular enum, const enum, and a string literal union? Why do many teams prefer union types over enums? enum Naam wale constants ka group — chalte waqt ek asli object banta hai. const enum Wahi, par compile hote waqt values inline ho jaati hain. Union of literals "a" | "b" — enum ka aksar behtar alternative. enum aisa lagta hai jaise TypeScript ka natural feature hai — par ye un chand cheezon mein se hai jo chalte waqt asli JavaScript code banati hain . Baaki poora type system compile ke baad gayab ho jaa

TypeScript checks shape compatibility, not nominal identity. Excess property checking only applies to fresh object literals — not to variables already typed. What is structural typing and how does it differ from nominal typing? What is excess property checking and why does it only apply to object literals? Structural typing Type match hota hai shape se, naam se nahi. Nominal typing Type match hota hai naam se — Java/C# ka tarika. TS mein nahi. Excess property check Object literal seedha assign karne par extra fields par error. TypeScript ye nahi dekhta ki type ka naam kya hai — wo dekhta hai ki uska shape match karta hai ya nahi. Agar object mein zaroori fields hain, to wo us type ka maana j

keyof T yields a union of known public property names of T. typeof gives you the type of a value at the type level — essential for extracting types from values. What does keyof T produce? How does typeof value differ from a type annotation? Show three real uses of combining keyof and typeof. keyof Type ki saari keys ka union nikalta hai. typeof Ek value ka type nikalta hai (type ki duniya mein). Do chhote operators jo milkar TypeScript ka sabse zyada use hone wala pattern banate hain. keyof T = T ki saari keys ka union. typeof x = value x ka type. Dono mila kar: "is object ki keys ka type de do".

T[K] accesses the type at key K within T. Supports nested access, union keys, and extends keyof constraints. Enables type-safe property lookups. How do you write an indexed access type in TypeScript? Show three examples: simple property, nested property, and union key access. Indexed access T[K] — type ke andar se ek field ka type nikalna. T[number] Array type ke andar ka element type. Jaise value se user.name nikalte ho, waise hi type se User["name"] nikal sakte ho. Aur array ke liye T[number] — "is array ke andar kya hai".

Functions with return type parameterName is Type act as type predicates. They tell TypeScript to narrow a type if the function returns true. What is a user-defined type guard? Implement isFish(pet: Fish | Bird): pet is Fish. What exactly does the is keyword do at the type level? Type guard Aisa function jo boolean lautaye aur TypeScript ko type bhi bata de. is x is Dog — return type ki jagah likha jaane wala khaas syntax. Type predicate Wahi x is Dog wala hissa. Normal function boolean lautata hai — TypeScript ko usse kuch pata nahi chalta. Type guard mein aap boolean ki jagah x is Dog likhte ho, aur ab TS if ke andar type narrow kar deta hai.

Functions that throw if a condition fails, telling the compiler to narrow types (asserts x is T). Added in TypeScript 3.7. Cleaner than if !throw patterns. What is an assertion function? Write assertIsDefined (val: T | undefined): asserts val is T. How does it differ from a type guard? Assertion function Aisa function jo galat hone par throw kare — aur uske baad TS type maan le. asserts asserts x is T — return type ki jagah likha jaane wala syntax. Type guard true / false deta hai aur aap if likhte ho. Assertion function galat hone par throw kar deta hai — aur us line ke baad TypeScript maan leta hai ki type sahi hai. Koi if nahi.

Type parameters that make code reusable across types. Constraints (extends) restrict what T can be. Defaults provide fallback types. Explain generics deeply. What is a generic constraint? What is a generic default? When does TypeScript fail to infer a generic and you must annotate? Generic Type ko khaali jagah chhod dena, aur use karte waqt bharna. Type parameter Wo khaali jagah — aksar T . Constraint T extends ... — khaali jagah par shart. Ek function jo kisi bhi type ke saath chale, par type khoye bina . any se bhi har type chal jaata hai — par wahan type kho jaata hai. Generic se identity("hi") aapko string wapas deta hai, any nahi.

T extends U ? X : Y — evaluated at the type level. Distributes over union members by default. Enables type-level computation. How do conditional types work? What is distributive behaviour over unions and when does it produce surprising results? Conditional type Type ki duniya ka if-else — A extends B ? X : Y . extends (yahan) Inheritance nahi — "kya ye us type mein fit hota hai?" Type level par if . Padho aise: " agar A, B mein fit hota hai to X, warna Y". Yahan extends ka matlab inheritance nahi hai — matlab hai "assignable hai kya".

Transform every property of an existing type: { [K in keyof T]: ... }. Used to build Partial, Readonly, Pick, and custom transformations. What are mapped types? Build Partial , Readonly , and Nullable from scratch using only mapped types and no built-in utilities. Mapped type Ek type ki saari keys par ghoom kar naya type banana. Modifier readonly aur ? — inhe + / - se jod-hata sakte ho. Jaise array.map() har item par ghoomta hai, waise mapped type har key par ghoomta hai aur naya type banata hai. Partial , Required , Readonly , Record — ye chaaron mapped types hain, aur chaaron 2-3 line ke hain.

Combine string literal types using template syntax: `${A}${B}`. Enables type-safe event names, CSS properties, and path strings. What are template literal types? Show 3 real-world use cases where they catch bugs at compile time that would otherwise be silent runtime errors. Template literal type String types ko jod kar naya string type banana. Intrinsic types Uppercase , Lowercase , Capitalize — built-in string helpers. Jaise value level par backtick string mein ${name} likh kar jodte ho, waise hi type level par string types jod sakte ho. Union ke saath mila do to ye saare combinations bana deta hai — automatically.

Extract a type from within a conditional type. Used to pull out return types, promise values, array element types, and function parameters. What does infer do inside a conditional type? Implement ReturnType , Awaited , and UnpackArray using infer from scratch. infer Conditional type ke andar "yahan jo bhi hai use pakad lo aur naam de do". infer ka ek hi kaam hai: kisi type ke andar se ek hissa nikal lena. Padho aise: "agar T Promise<kuch> jaisa dikhta hai, to us kuch ko U naam do aur wahi lauta do."

Types that reference themselves — for trees, nested JSON, deeply nested objects. TypeScript supports recursive types with some depth limits. How do you define a recursive type in TypeScript? Implement DeepPartial and DeepReadonly . Recursive type Aisa type jo apne andar khud ko use kare. Depth limit TypeScript ~50 level tak hi jaata hai, phir haar maan leta hai. Type khud ko reference kar sakta hai — jaise recursive function. JSON, tree, nested config — sab isi se model hote hain. Aur mapped types ke saath mila kar aap DeepPartial jaise utilities bana sakte ho.

Tuple types can spread other tuples using ...T syntax — enables typed rest parameters, Concat, Zip, and function argument manipulation. What are variadic tuple types? How do they enable building typed Concat or typed function composition with exact argument types? Tuple Fixed length aur fixed order wala array — [string, number] . Variadic Tuple ke andar ...T — "baaki jo bhi ho". Tuple types ke andar spread ( ... ) use karna. Isse aap "pehla argument ye, baaki jo bhi ho" jaise types likh sakte ho. Imaandari se: ye roz kaam nahi aata. Ye tab chahiye jab aap bind , curry ya pipe jaise function transform karne wale utilities likh rahe ho.

When a conditional type acts on a generic type T that is a union, it distributes over each member. This enables type-level operations like Exclude, Extract, and custom filters. What is distribution in conditional types? Why does T extends U ? X : Y distribute over unions of T? Show how Exclude leverages this. Distributive Conditional type ka union ke har member par alag-alag chalna. Naked type parameter T extends X — jahan T akela likha ho, bina bracket ke. Jab conditional type ka input ek union ho aur T akela likha ho, TypeScript us type ko union ke har member par alag chalata hai aur nateeje ko dobara union bana deta hai. Ye aksar chahiye hota hai — aur kabhi-kabhi bilkul nahi.

Mapped types support key remapping with as: { [K in keyof T as NewKey]: T[K] }. Enables prefixing, suffixing, filtering, and transforming object keys at the type level. What is key remapping in TypeScript mapped types? Show how to: prefix all keys with "_", filter out functions from an object type, and make all keys optional. Key remapping Mapped type ke andar as se keys ke naam badalna . never se filter Key ko never bana do to wo poori tarah hat jaati hai. Mapped type mein as lagakar aap key ka naam badal sakte ho — ya use never banakar hata sakte ho.

TypeScript 4.1+ provides Uppercase, Lowercase, Capitalize, Uncapitalize as intrinsic types — handled by the compiler, not expressible in userland. Used in template literal type transformations. What are intrinsic string types in TypeScript? Show how Capitalize, Uncapitalize, Uppercase, and Lowercase work. Why are they "intrinsic" and not implementable by users? Intrinsic Compiler ke andar bana hua — TypeScript mein likha hi nahi ja sakta. Chaar built-in string types: Uppercase , Lowercase , Capitalize , Uncapitalize . Ye intrinsic hain — matlab compiler ke andar C++ mein likhe hain, TypeScript mein nahi. Isliye aap inhe khud nahi bana sakte.

n: Abstract Classes — abstract methods, constructor access, vs interfaces
x: Abstract classes can't be instantiated directly. Abstract methods have no body — subclasses must implement them. Unlike interfaces, abstract classes can have constructors, state, and concrete methods. Use when you need shared implementation across related classes. What is the difference between an abstract class and an interface in TypeScript? When would you use each? abstract class Adhoori class — usse seedha object nahi ban sakta. abstract method Sirf naam, koi body nahi — bachche ko likhna padega. Ek class jo adhoori hai. Usme kuch methods poori hoti hain (sabke liye same) aur kuch abstract — jo har bachche ko khud likhni padti hain. new AbstractClass() nahi chalta — pehle use poora karna

n: Variance Annotations — in, out, invariant on type parameters
x: TypeScript 4.7+ supports variance annotations: out T (covariant), in T (contravariant), in out T (invariant). Controls how type parameter subtyping works. Methods are contravariant in parameters, covariant in return types by default with strictFunctionTypes. What are variance annotations in TypeScript? What does `in` and `out` mean on a type parameter? Covariant (out) Type parameter sirf bahar aata hai (return position). Contravariant (in) Type parameter sirf andar jaata hai (parameter position). Invariant Dono jagah — to na chauda kar sakte ho na patla. TypeScript khud pata laga leta hai ki generic type parameter kaise behave karta hai. in / out se aap wo likh kar bata sakte ho. Imaandari s

Partial makes all props optional. Required makes all required. Readonly prevents reassignment. None are deep — they only affect the top level. Implement Partial , Required , Readonly from scratch using mapped types. What are their limitations (shallow only)? Partial Saare fields optional bana do. Required Saare fields zaroori bana do. Readonly Saare fields badalne se rok do. Teen mapped types jo ek hi type ke alag-alag roop bana dete hain — bina poora interface dobara likhe. Teeno ka andar ka code 2-2 line ka hai, aur teeno shallow hain.

Pick/Omit work on object keys. Extract/Exclude work on union members. They are often confused because the names are symmetrical. What is the difference between Omit and Exclude ? What is the difference between Pick and Extract ? Give concrete examples. Pick Sirf ye keys rakho. Omit Ye keys hata do. Extract / Exclude Union par kaam karte hain, object par nahi. Chaar utilities, do jodiyan — aur ye jodiyan alag cheezon par kaam karti hain, jo sabse aam confusion hai. Pick / Omit → object ki keys par. Extract / Exclude → union ke members par.

Creates an object type with keys of type K and values of type V. Stronger than { [key: string]: V } because it enforces all union keys are present. When is Record better than { [key: string]: V }? How does Record with a union key enforce exhaustive key handling? Record Aisa object jiski saari keys K type ki hon aur values V type ki. Record<K, V> = "in keys wala object, jinki values V type ki hon". Andar se ye ek line ka mapped type hai: { [P in K]: V } .

Extract types from function signatures without repeating them — essential for wrappers, decorators, and middleware. What does ReturnType do internally (hint: infer)? Show 3 real use cases for Parameters and ReturnType in production code. ReturnType Function ka return type nikalo. Parameters Function ke arguments ka tuple nikalo. typeof fn Function value se uska type nikalo. Function se type nikalne wale utilities. Teeno infer se bane hain. Aur inka sabse kaam ka pattern ek hi hai: ReturnType<typeof fn> .

Recursively unwraps Promise to get T. Handles nested Promises and thenables. Added in TS 4.5 to replace the broken ReturnType pattern. Why was Awaited added in TypeScript 4.5? What was broken about using ReturnType to type async functions before it? Awaited Promise ke andar ki value ka type — chahe kitni bhi layers ho. Awaited<Promise<string>> = string . Aur agar promise ke andar promise ho, to wo bhi khol deta hai — jaise await khud karta hai.

Combine generics, conditional types, mapped types, and infer to create domain-specific utility types. Build these from scratch: DeepPartial , Mutable (reverse of Readonly), FunctionKeys (only keys whose values are functions). Custom utility Apna banaya hua reusable type helper. Built-in utilities kaafi nahi padte. Kuch helpers har project mein chahiye hote hain aur TypeScript unhe deta nahi. Yahan wo paanch hain jo sabse zyada kaam aate hain.

NonNullable removes null and undefined from T. Useful after filter(Boolean) or in combination with Partial. Not deep — only removes top-level nullability. What does NonNullable do? Implement it from scratch. Why does Array .filter(Boolean) not automatically narrow the type to NonNullable ? NonNullable null aur undefined hata do. Ek line ka utility: NonNullable<string | null> = string . Andar se: T extends null | undefined ? never : T .

NoInfer (TS 5.4+) prevents TypeScript from using that position for generic inference. Forces callers to provide a type explicitly while still constraining it. What does NoInfer do? Show a use case where it prevents TypeScript from inferring a too-wide type from one parameter versus another. NoInfer TypeScript se kaho: "is jagah se type mat pehchano". Jab ek generic type do jagah aata hai, TypeScript dono se infer karta hai aur unhe mila deta hai — aur nateeja aksar chauda ho jaata hai. NoInfer<T> se aap ek jagah ko inference se bahar kar dete ho.

ThisType defines the this context inside an object literal (used in Vue options API, Svelte, and chain builders). ThisParameterType and OmitThisParameter extract/remove the this parameter from a function. What does ThisType do? How is it used in framework types like Vue's Options API? What happens without it? ThisType Object literal ke andar this ka type set karo. ThisParameterType Function ke this parameter ka type nikalo. Do bahut kam use hone wale utilities jo this ke saath kaam karte hain. Imaandari se: ThisType ki zarurat aaj lagbhag nahi padti — wo Vue 2 jaise this -based APIs ke liye tha. Par interview mein naam aa jaata hai.

Uppercase, Lowercase, Capitalize, Uncapitalize are built-in intrinsic types. Frequently used with template literal types for key transformation and naming convention enforcement. List all 4 intrinsic string utilities. Show how to build a type that converts camelCase to kebab-case and back using these utilities. Intrinsic Compiler ke andar bana hua — TypeScript mein likha hi nahi ja sakta. Chaar string utilities: Uppercase , Lowercase , Capitalize , Uncapitalize . In par poori lesson "Intrinsic String Manipulation Types" mein hai — yahan bas ye yaad rakho ki ye utility types ke parivaar ka hissa hain aur baaki utilities se alag hain: baaki TypeScript mein likhe hain, ye compiler ke an

Controls strict checks, compilation target, module output format, path aliases, and project references. Getting tsconfig wrong causes silent runtime bugs. Explain these 10 tsconfig options: strict, target, module, moduleResolution, esModuleInterop, paths, baseUrl, isolatedModules, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes. tsconfig.json TypeScript ki settings file — project ki jad. include / exclude Kaunsi files check honi hain. extends Doosri config se settings udhaar lena. Ek file jo tay karti hai ki TypeScript kitna sakht hoga, kaunsi files dekhega, aur output kaisa banayega. Ismein 100+ options hain. Sirf 8-10 sach mein maayne rakhte hain — baaki default theek hain.

strict enables: strictNullChecks, noImplicitAny, strictFunctionTypes, strictPropertyInitialization, strictBindCallApply, strictBuiltinIteratorReturn, useUnknownInCatchVariables, noImplicitThis. What are all the flags that strict enables? Which ones cause the most pain when enabling on a legacy JavaScript codebase? strict Ek switch jo 8 alag flags on kar deta hai. strictNullChecks Inme se sabse zyada faayda dene wala. "strict": true ek shortcut hai — wo 8 alag flags on karta hai. Har ek apni tarah ki galti pakadta hai. Inme se strictNullChecks akela hi TypeScript ka aadha faayda deta hai.

Type definitions without implementation. Libraries ship them or you install via @types/*. Declaration merging adds to existing types. What is a .d.ts file? When do you write one vs install @types/*? What is the difference between declare module and declare global? .d.ts Sirf types wali file — koi chalne wala code nahi. DefinitelyTyped @types/* packages ka repo. declare "Ye cheez kahin aur hai, uska type ye hai". Ek file jisme sirf types hote hain, koi code nahi. Ye JavaScript libraries par types "chipkane" ke liye hoti hai. Aap teen jagah milengi: library ke andar, @types/* package mein, ya aapke apne project mein.

TS compiles to CJS, ESM, or others. Module resolution (how imports are found) is separate from module format (what is emitted). Mixing them causes import errors. What is the difference between CommonJS and ESM output from TypeScript? What breaks when a CJS consumer requires an ESM package? ESM import / export — standard. CommonJS require / module.exports — Node ka purana. moduleResolution TypeScript kaise dhundta hai ki import kahan se aaya. TypeScript mein module ka jhanjhat teen settings ka mila-jula nateeja hai: module , moduleResolution , aur package.json ka "type" . Zyadatar "Cannot find module" wali errors inhi teeno ke aapas mein na milne se aati hain.

Split a large monorepo into sub-projects with their own tsconfig. TypeScript builds only what changed using .tsbuildinfo files. What are TypeScript project references? How do they speed up large monorepo builds? What is composite: true and why is it required? Project references Ek TS project doosre par nirbhar — alag-alag build hote hain. Incremental Sirf badla hua hissa dobara compile karna. composite Wo flag jo project ko reference-able banata hai. Bade repos mein sab kuch ek saath compile karna slow hai. Project references se aap use tukdon mein baant dete ho, aur TypeScript sirf badle hue tukde dobara banata hai.

TypeScript exposes its compiler as a public API. Used by ESLint, ts-morph, and custom build tools to analyse and transform code. What is the TypeScript Compiler API? What can you do with it that you cannot do with regular type checking alone? Compiler API TypeScript ko library ki tarah use karna. AST Abstract Syntax Tree — code ka tree roop. ts-morph Compiler API ka aasan wrapper. TypeScript sirf ek compiler nahi — ek library bhi hai. Aap use import karke code parse kar sakte ho, uska tree ghoom sakte ho, aur naya code likh sakte ho. Raw API bhaari hai; ts-morph uska aasan wrapper hai aur zyadatar kaam ke liye wahi use karna chahiye.

Source maps map compiled JS back to TS for debugging. Declaration maps map .d.ts back to .ts source for IDE go-to-definition. Essential for library authors. What is the difference between sourceMap and declarationMap? Why should library authors ship declaration maps? How does "go to source" work in node_modules? Source map Compiled code ko wapas asli code se jodne wali file. Declaration map .d.ts ko asli source se jodne wali file. Browser aapka compiled JS chalata hai, par aapko apna TypeScript debug karna hai. Source map wo pull hai jo dono ko jodta hai. Declaration map alag cheez hai: usse editor mein "Go to Definition" aapko .d.ts ki jagah asli source par le jaata hai.

jsx controls JSX emission: react (React.createElement), react-jsx (_jsx runtime, TS 4.1+), preserve (keep for Babel), react-native. jsxFactory, jsxFragmentFactory for custom runtimes. What are the TS jsx options and when should you use each? What changed with the automatic JSX runtime (react-jsx) and why is it preferred? jsx: react-jsx Naya transform — import React ki zarurat nahi. .tsx Wo file extension jisme JSX likha ja sakta hai. Ek setting jo tay karti hai ki JSX kaise compile hoga. Aaj ka sahi jawab "react-jsx" hai.

target sets the JS language level (ES2015, ES2020, ESNext). lib specifies which ambient declarations to include. module sets the output module system. These three interact. What is the interaction between target, lib, and module in tsconfig? Why would you set target: ES2015 but lib: ES2023? What does "lib" actually control? target Output JavaScript kis version ka hoga. lib Kaunse built-in types available honge. DOM lib Browser ke APIs ke types. Do settings jo aapas mein juri hain aur aksar confuse karti hain: target = "output kis JS version mein hoga". lib = "kaunse built-in types mujhe dikhenge". target set karne par lib apne aap set ho jaati hai — par aap use override kar sakte ho.

paths and baseUrl enable import aliases like @/components/Button instead of ../../../components/Button. Requires matching bundler config (vite, webpack, tsconfig-paths at runtime). How do you configure path aliases in TypeScript? What is the relationship between baseUrl and paths? Why do path aliases need separate runtime configuration? paths Import path ka shortcut — @/utils . baseUrl Wo folder jisse relative paths shuru hote hain. ../../../utils/format ki jagah @/utils/format likhna.
